title: Sensitivity as a sum of indicators
statement: For a sign-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and an input $x$, the real-valued sensitivity at $x$ equals the sum over coordinates of the indicator that flipping that coordinate changes the value of $f$.
